name: Pentamaster Corporation Berhad
summary: Pentamaster Corporation Berhad, an investment holding company, provides automation manufacturing and technology solutions. It operates in three segments: Automated Test Equipment, Factory Automation Solutions, and Smart Control Solution System. The company offers standard and non-standard automated equipment; integrated automated manufacturing solutions; and property project management, smart building solutions, and trading of materials.
